ai-creation-workflow.brief: Controls an AI creative project and its stage graph.
ai-creation-workflow.use_when: The request spans dependent creative or execution stages.
ai-creation-workflow.boundary: Delegates craft artifacts and backend operations to specialist skills.

skill-governor.brief: Discovers, maps, evaluates and safely updates skills.
skill-governor.use_when: A capability is missing, duplicated, stale or being maintained.
skill-governor.boundary: Does not run the creative project or author specialist artifacts.

h3-runtime-router.brief: Chooses and authorizes local or cloud MiniMax H3 execution.
h3-runtime-router.use_when: An approved H3 segment is ready to render.
h3-runtime-router.boundary: Does not write prompts or submit directly without a backend adapter.

comfyui-local-runner.brief: Runs an API-format ComfyUI workflow on a local server.
comfyui-local-runner.use_when: The local runtime is selected and its exact API workflow is available.
comfyui-local-runner.boundary: Does not start ComfyUI, convert UI workflows or design prompts.

minimax-h3-cloud.brief: Runs an installed MiniMax H3 workflow on an AutoDL application instance.
minimax-h3-cloud.use_when: The cloud runtime is selected and the exact installed workflow is approved.

autodl-app-instance.brief: Lists, starts, discovers and stops AutoDL application instances.
autodl-app-instance.use_when: A cloud backend needs a current instance and panel endpoint.
autodl-app-instance.boundary: Does not submit generation jobs or release instances.
